insights.one_liner: Walker & Dunlop is a NYSE-listed US commercial real estate finance firm from Bethesda, with two senior data and software roles in the Amsterdam area.

culture.text: A US company of about 1,499 employees headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland; staff mostly come from US universities like Maryland and Virginia.
Most people work in finance, business development, operations and sales, with a smaller IT function.

growth.text: Founded in 1937 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
Recently arranged large US refinancings, including $630.6 million for an IMT Capital multifamily portfolio.

worth_knowing.text: Walker & Dunlop Investment Partners fully invested its $136 million Fund VII.
